title: क्या है पूरे Protest का सच ? Explained | Jantar Mantar Protest | CJP | @RJRaunac
summary: The comment section is split and loud. Close to half of the 300 most liked comments accuse Raunac of siding with the government (words like chatukar, dalal, godi media, 'paid'), while about a quarter thank Delhi Police and back the government's action against the protest. Under the noise there is a real request: cover the protest's actual issues and the government's mistakes too.
summary_hi: कमेंट सेक्शन बँटा हुआ है और काफ़ी तीखा है। सबसे ज़्यादा लाइक वाले 300 कमेंट्स में से लगभग आधे रौनक पर सरकार का पक्ष लेने का आरोप लगाते हैं (चाटुकार, दलाल, गोदी मीडिया, 'बिक गया'), जबकि क़रीब एक चौथाई दिल्ली पुलिस को धन्यवाद देते हैं और प्रोटेस्ट पर सरकार की कार्रवाई का समर्थन करते हैं। शोर के नीचे एक असली माँग है: प्रोटेस्ट के असली मुद्दों और सरकार की गलतियों पर भी वीडियो बनाइए।

themes.label: Accusations of bias
themes.note: Chatukar, dalal, godi media, 'how much were you paid': viewers say the video defends the government.

themes.label: Support for Delhi Police and the government
themes.note: Thank you Delhi Police, full support to the government, the detentions were right.

themes.label: Praise and greetings for Raunac
themes.note: Jai Shri Ram, festival wishes and a few direct messages of support for the creator.

themes.label: The 'kachra saaf' line
themes.note: The moment at 0:27 is quoted again and again as 'Swachh Bharat Abhiyan'.

themes.label: Issues the video left out
themes.note: Manipur, vote chori, the Election Commission, an 'undeclared emergency', why so much police.

themes.label: Lost trust
themes.note: Former fans saying 'this was not expected from you', threats to unsubscribe, views are falling.

comments.author: @kanhasharma6482
comments.text: Ronak ki kabhi government ke galat kaam par video nahi dekhi j
comments.text_en: I have never seen a video from Raunac on the government's wrongdoing.
comments.highlight: kabhi government ke galat kaam par video nahi dekhi
comments.why: The calmest version of what nearly half the comment section is saying: the complaint is about one-sided coverage, and it names what would fix it.
comments.reply: Baat sahi jagah lagi hai. Jahan sarkar galat hai, us par bhi video banegi. Aap batao kaunsa mudda sabse pehle uthana chahiye?

comments.author: @kenindia5926
comments.text:
Sahi se chatna koi kami na rahe😂
Jo mudde ki baat thi bo kaha hai😢
comments.text_en: Make sure you flatter properly, leave nothing out. Where is the actual issue that mattered?
comments.highlight: Jo mudde ki baat thi bo kaha hai
comments.why: 147 likes on a viewer saying the video skipped what the protest was actually about. That is specific feedback on the content, not just a taunt.
comments.reply: Mudde ki baat aap ke hisaab se kya thi? Likh do, agli video usi par rakhta hoon.

comments.author: @IshitaReddy-08s
comments.text: ARNAB BRO YADI FLOP SHOW HAI TOH SARKAR DARR KYU RHI HAI CRPSF CSPF ARMIES COMMANDOS POLICE 40,000 POLICE KO KYU DEPLOY KIYA ?
comments.text_en: Arnab bro, if it is a flop show then why is the government scared? Why deploy CRPF, CISF, armies, commandos, 40,000 police?
comments.why: A direct challenge to the video's argument that deserves a straight answer: if the protest was small, why the heavy deployment?
comments.reply: Sawaal theek hai. Deployment itna bada kyun tha, is par alag se baat karni chahiye. Agli video mein iska jawab dunga.

comments.author: @sabnambegam3292
comments.text: Emergency लग गाया मतलब प्रोटेस्ट successful हुयी है, मणिपुर का नाम सुने हैं किया? मणिपुर explain video बनाये pl. कास मणिपुर पे Emergency लगता तो 😢😢😢
comments.text_en: If an emergency was imposed, the protest was successful. Have you heard of Manipur? Please make a Manipur explainer video. If only an emergency had been imposed over Manipur.
comments.why: A clear video request, and Manipur comes up in two more comments as the example of where this force was missing.
comments.reply: मणिपुर पर explain video की बात नोट कर ली है। आप उसमें सबसे पहले क्या समझना चाहेंगी?

comments.author: @abhaypratapsing7275
comments.text: 0:27 Kachara saf was epic 😅😅😂. Swachh Bharat abhiyan
comments.text_en: 0:27, 'the trash got cleaned up' was epic. Clean India campaign.
comments.why: The most liked comment by far (1,700) and it gives a timestamp: the line at 0:27 is the moment the supportive half of the audience is quoting, in about a dozen comments.
comments.reply: 0:27 wali line sabko yaad reh gayi 😄 Dekhne ke liye shukriya!

comments.author: @DEV.KUMAR-1994
comments.text: जब झारखंड पंजाब में पेपर लीक हुआ था स्टूडेंट आवाज उठा रहे थे उन्हें पीटा जा रहा था तब इन तीनों की आंखें बंद हो गई थी कोई बयान नहीं दिया जा रहा था क्योंकि वहां मलिक की सरकार है
comments.text_en: When papers leaked in Jharkhand and Punjab and students who raised their voice were being beaten, these three had their eyes shut and gave no statement, because their master's government is in power there.
comments.highlight: जब झारखंड पंजाब में पेपर लीक हुआ था
comments.why: 182 likes from the supportive side pointing at a comparison the audience wants spelled out: how protests were treated in opposition-run states.
comments.reply: झारखंड और पंजाब के पेपर लीक वाले प्रोटेस्ट पर भी बात होनी चाहिए। इसे अगली वीडियो की लिस्ट में रख रहा हूँ।

comments.author: @golukumar-jq6od
comments.text: इसी वजह से अपना  view देखो धीरे धीरे गिरता जा रहा है
comments.text_en: This is the reason your views are slowly going down, look at them.
comments.highlight: view देखो धीरे धीरे गिरता जा रहा है
comments.why: A viewer tying the channel's numbers to the perceived bias, with 82 likes. Worth checking against real retention data.
comments.reply: आपकी बात सुनी। कौन सी वीडियो के बाद आपको ऐसा लगा, बताइए तो समझने में मदद मिलेगी।

comments.author: @AmritDewangan-l9w
comments.text: रौनक भईया  बहुत भरोसा था आपके ऊपर पर ऐसा लगता है आपका भी पेमेंट पहले आ गया । 🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼
comments.text_en: Raunac bhaiya, I had a lot of trust in you, but it looks like your payment also arrived in advance.
comments.why: A long-time viewer saying trust is breaking. The many 'did not expect this from you' comments come from people who were fans.
comments.reply: भरोसा टूटे, यह मैं नहीं चाहता। मुझे कोई पेमेंट नहीं मिलता, और आगे दोनों तरफ़ की बात रखूँगा। देखते रहिए और टोकते रहिए।

comments.author: @rahulmotivationinspiration9145
comments.text: Tum to phle wala protest ko flop btaya tha re bhai
comments.text_en: You called the earlier protest a flop too, brother.
comments.highlight: phle wala protest ko flop btaya tha
comments.why: Viewers remember the earlier video and see a pattern. A second comment says the same: against the protest then, against it now.
comments.reply: Haan, pehle bhi wahi kaha tha jo mujhe dikha. Is baar kya alag laga aapko? Batao.

comments.author: @probinborah-t2z
comments.text: Konsa court mai faisla hoga rounak bhaii yeh mamla aj court jyga toh 50 sal bad faisla hoga konsa court 😅😂😂protest koro or jldi jldi faisla lo
comments.text_en: Which court will decide this, Raunac bhai? If this matter goes to court today, the verdict will come after 50 years. Which court? Protest and get a decision quickly.
comments.why: Pushes back on the 'take it to court' argument with the real objection people have: courts are slow. Two other comments say the same.
comments.reply: Court mein der lagti hai, yeh sach hai. Par raasta kya ho jo jaldi bhi ho aur shaant bhi? Is par aapki rai sunna chahunga.

comments.author: @praveshbhanj4714
comments.text: Election commission,vote to Right, delhi police atrocities,rss bjp gunde protest me ye sab pe to bola nahi aur rahi baat aeroplane me koi government ke against narebazi karta to use bhi detained kar liya jata aur lifetime flight ke liye use banned kar diya jata so koi support me bola nahi cjp ke..aur cjp ke against jo bolta hai use police koi action nahi leti balki unko sarankshan diya jata hai.
comments.text_en: You did not speak about the Election Commission, the right to vote, Delhi Police atrocities, or RSS and BJP goons at the protest. And about the aeroplane: anyone shouting slogans against the government there would also be detained and banned from flying for life, so no one spoke in support of CJP. Those who speak against CJP face no police action, they are protected instead.
comments.highlight: ye sab pe to bola nahi
comments.why: The only comment that lists point by point what the video left out. A ready checklist for a follow-up.
comments.reply: Aapne jo points likhe hain, Election Commission se lekar police action tak, woh note kar liye. Follow-up mein in par baat karunga.

comments.author: @ArchanaSingh-lq5qx
comments.text: Protest is our right, but it must be peaceful. Those who speak about the Constitution should understand it too. If these are genuine concerns, raise them in court instead of creating chaos and spreading anarchy.
comments.highlight: raise them in court instead of creating chaos
comments.why: The most reasoned comment from the side that agrees with the video. It shows what the supportive audience took away.
comments.reply: Well put. Peaceful protest and the courts can go together. Thank you for writing this out so clearly.

comments.author: @vidyashetty4805
comments.text: RJ raunac you are awesome i support you
comments.why: One of the few viewers defending the creator by name in a hostile comment section.
comments.reply: Thank you, this means a lot today. Keep watching and keep telling me what you think.

ideas.title: जहाँ सरकार गलत है: प्रोटेस्ट के असली मुद्दे क्या थे? (vote chori, Election Commission, detentions)
ideas.why: The loudest constructive ask: show the other side and the protest's actual demands, not only why it failed.

ideas.title: मणिपुर Explained: तब यह फ़ोर्स कहाँ थी?
ideas.why: One direct request for a Manipur explainer and two more comments comparing the Delhi deployment with Manipur.

ideas.title: Court या सड़क: क्या अदालत से जल्दी इंसाफ़ मिल सकता है?
ideas.why: Viewers on both sides argue about 'go to court instead': some agree, others say a verdict takes decades.
